label: Da Nang
short_description: Han River city towers to the beach resorts along My Khe and Non Nuoc, spanning Da Nang and the Hoi An coast.
intro: Da Nang's hotels in this directory split between two settings: the Han River waterfront in the city center -- walkable to the Dragon Bridge, downtown dining and the airport -- and the long beach strip running south down the coast, where resorts line My Khe, Bac My An and Non Nuoc beaches toward the Marble Mountains. The coverage stretches a little further south again to the Da Nang-Hoi An corridor, where beachfront resorts sit within easy reach of Hoi An's UNESCO ancient town. City-center hotels suit business and short stops near the airport; the beach and Hoi An-corridor resorts suit longer leisure stays.
